exitHint: Press Escape twice to leave. This does not erase browser history or the encrypted vault.
reassure: You can stop anytime. You decide what happens next.
eyebrow: PRIVATE BY DESIGN · HERE FOR YOU
headline: You deserve to feel safe.
intro: Preserve what happened and find your next step, at your own pace.
localBody: Images never leave this browser. Only text you choose to send and evidence metadata reach the local backend.
stepsIntro: A little clarity, one step at a time
step1Body: Three simple questions. No account needed.
step2Body: Create a private, encrypted record on this device.
step3Body: Review cited guidance and editable document drafts.
question: Question
dangerBody: If you can do so safely, contact emergency support. You can continue when you are ready.
minorBody: Call 1098 or 112 for urgent support. Consider involving a trusted adult you feel safe with.
pocso: POCSO may be relevant. Needs verification: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, sections 11 and 19.
verifyNumbers: Verify numbers and availability in your area.
stopNote: For eligible adults and images taken at 18 or older. Participating platforms only. Check eligibility on the service.
takeDown: Take It Down · images taken under 18
external: External services have their own privacy policies. This app does not send reports.
vaultSubtitle: The files stay on your device. This vault keeps only encrypted hashes and metadata.
passHelp: Use at least 12 characters. Keep it safe: there is no reset. On a shared device, lock the vault when you finish.
unlockError: Could not unlock the vault. Check your passphrase or browser storage access.
passError: Use a passphrase with at least 12 characters.
demoNote: Synthetic demo only. Your real timeline is unchanged.
demoLoaded: Synthetic timeline loaded. You can verify it or simulate tampering.
tampered: One synthetic stored entry was changed. Verify the chain to find it.
emptyVaultBody: Choose a file to record its hash, or explore with synthetic demo data.
fileHelp: Up to 25 MB per file, 200 entries. No file is uploaded or saved by this app.
fileLimit: Use files under 25 MB and no more than 200 entries.
delimiter: Remove the | character from file names, platform or notes before logging.
saved: Encrypted metadata saved on this device.
originals: Keep your original files safe. The hash proves they have not changed since you logged them.
hashLimit: Compare against a trusted recorded hash. A local chain does not prove authorship, an independent timestamp or court admissibility; someone with access can rewrite the whole chain.
tips: Do not delete anything. Do not reply to the abuser.
minorEvidence: For a minor, seek specialist help on safe preservation. Do not download or forward sexual images to use this app.
exportPrivacy: PDF generation sends metadata and hashes to the local backend. Downloaded PDFs are not encrypted; store them safely.
checkFirst: Verify the chain before adding more evidence.
detailsSubtitle: These details stay in memory until you explicitly request extraction, guidance or a document. Refreshing clears them.
ocrHelp: Choose a text-only screenshot. OCR runs here, in your browser. Review the text before sending it.
extractNotice: Only this edited text is sent to the backend. If you configure an AI provider, it also receives the text.
ocrError: Could not read this screenshot. Try a clearer image or type the text below.
extractDone: Details extracted. Review and edit every field below.
guidanceSubtitle: Possible provisions for review, based on this small corpus. Applicability must be checked by a qualified professional.
legalEnglish: Legal summaries and document bodies may remain in English. Translations are best effort.
noMatch: Nothing in this corpus matches your description. Do not infer that no remedy exists; seek qualified help.
textNotice: Your typed details are sent to the backend for this action. Files and images are never sent.
documentsTitle: A starting point for your report.
documentsSubtitle: Review the facts, fill the blanks and get appropriate review before filing. Nothing is submitted automatically.
sectionNote: BSA 2023, section 63 and Schedule: this preparation draft needs party and expert review. It is not a completed statutory certificate.
draftReady: Draft ready. Review it before downloading.
checklistTitle: You do not have to do everything now.
checklistSubtitle: A small plan you can return to. Only these check marks are saved locally, without your case details.
checkSafe: Find a safe place and a trusted person to support you.
checkOriginal: Keep original messages, URLs and files safe.
checkVault: Log evidence and verify your timeline.
checkReport: Review the official platform and cybercrime reporting options.
checkDraft: Review your complaint and takedown drafts.
checkSupport: Speak with a qualified lawyer or support worker.
checkFollow: Keep acknowledgements and follow up on your reports.
error: This action could not be completed. Check that the backend is running and try again.
offline: You appear to be offline. The vault still works. Backend actions need a running local server.
privacyFooter: No account. No original files stored. Your pace.
demoDescription: Synthetic demo: On 2026-10-05, @demo_account on Instagram threatened to leak private images. This is fictional test data.
demoChanged: Synthetic note edited for tamper test
clearSession: Session locked. In-memory case details cleared.
fieldRequired: Add a short description of what happened.
chainEmpty: Add evidence before verifying the chain.
storageError: Browser storage is unavailable. Check marks could not be saved.
